welcome.title: Every country, capital and flag, learned for good
welcome.lead: A few minutes a day. Each card comes back just before you would forget it, and the gap grows every time you remember.
welcome.optional: Off until you switch it on
welcome.timeBody: At about {{minutes}} minutes a day you meet every country card within about {{weeks}} weeks, and know them all in about {{months}} months.
welcome.timeAll: With every topic switched on: about {{months}} months.
welcome.demoDone: That is GeoDex. A real session adapts to you: what you miss comes back sooner.
welcome.facts: Free, and it works offline. Your progress stays in this browser.
welcome.memory: Wrong answers come back the same day. Countries you mix up get a card of their own that tells the two apart.
welcome.close: Pick your home country and the first session starts. There is nothing to sign up for.

intro.title: A few minutes a day
intro.body: Each day has a short session: the cards due for review and a few new countries. Three things to know, then you are ready.

length.title: Pick a session length
length.body: Try 5 questions for a first go. You can change this before every session.

input.title: Choose how you answer
input.body: Auto starts with choices and moves to typing as you get better. You can also pick one yourself.

progress.title: Your map and level
progress.body: Countries you start fill in on the map, and the region you learn next is marked. The level shows how much you remember right now. Stats has the full picture.

help.lead: How GeoDex grades, schedules and counts your progress, and where it keeps it.

welcome.name: First screen
welcome.body: A sample question, what you can learn and how long it takes.

today.name: Today
today.body: Start a session, and see what is due, your map and your level.

atlas.name: Atlas
atlas.body: Your map per skill, country pages, borders over time.

settings.name: Settings
settings.body: Topics, daily time, language, appearance, sound and backups.

help.gradingBody: You never grade yourself. Wrong is wrong. A right answer counts as good, as hard after a hint, a typo or a slow answer, or as easy when you type or tap it fast.
help.harderBody: A new card asks with choices on a close map. As you remember it for longer, you type the answer and the map zooms out to the continent, then the world.
help.scheduleBody: Each card returns just before you would forget it. Miss one and it comes back soon; know it and the gap grows.
help.keysBody: In a session: 1 to 4 choose, Enter submits and continues, H shows a hint, Esc ends. Press ? for the full list.
help.xpBody: XP only goes up: correct answers, finished sessions, study days, your daily goal, and cards that hold for a week, three weeks and two months. XP earns ranks, from Tourist to Atlas keeper.
help.goalBody: Reach your daily time or finish a number of sessions; choose which in Settings. Meeting it earns XP and counts the day for your streak, even with reviews left.
help.levelsBody: Your level shows how much you remember right now. It rises as cards hold for longer and slips if you forget.
help.progressBody: Progress is saved in this browser after every answer, and nowhere else. Clearing the browser's data erases it. Download a backup in Settings now and then, and use it to move to another device.
